# UQDA Core v0.1.7

This maintenance release clarifies uninstaller dry-run output.

## Uninstaller

- Dry-run actions now say `would remove` instead of `remove`.
- Dry-run completion explicitly states that no files were changed.
- Purge dry-run explains that the command must be repeated without
  `--dry-run` and confirmed by typing `PURGE`.
- Adds regression tests preventing dry-run output from falsely reporting a
  completed removal.

The safety behavior is unchanged: `--dry-run` never mutates the system, and
an actual `--purge` still requires explicit confirmation.
